title: Observing Conformal Floquet Dynamics on a Digital Quantum Processor
summary: Quantum simulations are traditionally confined to exploring dynamics starting from unentangled or low-entanglement states due to severe bottlenecks in protocol design, hardware performance, and classical verification. Here, we report the first quantum simulation of non-equilibrium dynamics initiated directly from a many-body critical ground state. Using a fully-connected trapped-ion processor, we prepare the critical ground state of a transverse-field Ising model via a hardware-tailored, logarithmic-depth quantum circuit based on multi-scale entanglement renormalization.
